name: Residence by Investment as Rentier (Rentista)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires permanent monthly income of at least US$2,000 from foreign sources (dividends, property rental, or investment income) -- must show a 5-year documented history of the underlying shareholding, property, or investment.
Requires bank certification attesting receipt of the rent/income within Dominican territory for the previous residency period.

evidence_required.document: 5-year documented history of foreign shareholding, property, or investment generating the income
Bank certification of income received in the Dominican Republic
Medical exam from a DGM-authorized institution

sources.title: Dirección General de Migración -- Residence by Investment as Rentier: US$2,000/month minimum foreign income, 45 working days, fee breakdown (RD$28,800 + RD$3,500 + RD$6,300)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Dominican Republic). Distinct from do_pensionado_residence: this route is for investment/dividend/rental income (US$2,000/month), while the pensioner route is specifically for pension/retirement income (US$1,500/month) -- two separate DGM service pages with different thresholds, not variants of the same route. work_rights modeled 'none' since the underlying qualifying basis is passive foreign income, not local employment or business operation -- not explicitly stated as a restriction on this specific page, flagged as an inference from the route's structure and consistent with how this dataset treats equivalent passive-income routes elsewhere (e.g. Costa Rica's rentista/pensionado routes).
